partial.210: only its lower straight part, from where 238 joins it (~1597,559) down to Countdown (~1590,589); the upper curve of 210 from Buckhorn (~1576,481) to the Challenger (62) junction (~1600,546) is Challenger's lead-in, not Turkey Shoot - split 210 at ~1599,552 (upper = Challenger, lower = Turkey Shoot)

trails.note: Uses 238 (Summit Lodge down-left to 210) plus only the LOWER part of 210, from where 238 joins it down to Countdown. 210's upper curve from Buckhorn leads into Challenger 62; split 210 at ~1599,552. The 2-line label is parallel to 238 and spans its length; the diamond only touches 210 because the label's left end reaches it. OpenStreetMap agrees: Turkey Shoot runs from the lodge to Countdown, and Challenger starts on Buckhorn.

207+206 are certain: the RUM RUN label interrupts this line, and the painted cut runs from the summit plateau (~1729,500) to Upper Mountain Road (~1838,470). 245 is uncertain. It is a white-cased blue line in its own thin blue band just above the label, running from UMR near the lodge pointer and hooking into 206 at the label's end. Nothing else names it and it has no glade icon; drop 245 if the band is an unnamed glade.

No drawn line. The vertical SUNDOG label (green circle at the top, beside the summit fire tower) lies on a painted open corridor that runs from the summit down to Rim Rock (49), which it meets at ~1361,395. The trace follows that corridor and label. OpenStreetMap agrees: Sun Dog runs from the summit to Rimrock.

No drawn line. The vertical SCOOTER label runs down an open strip beside a tree island, from the end of Muellers' Run 63 (~1427,906), where Drop Off also arrives, to Link at the LINK square (~1459,996, end of 208). The trace follows the label. OpenStreetMap agrees: Scooter runs down to Link.

No drawn line. DROP OFF is printed across the slope in a painted cut that links Upper World Cup to the Muellers' Run end. The trace runs from Upper World Cup (~1542,886, behind its label, between the letters of WORLD) down-left to the Muellers'/Scooter junction (~1433,911). It is a traverse, not a fall-line run. OpenStreetMap continues it a little further into the slow zone, but the map shows nothing past the junction.
